overall.verdict: Light desktop is a calm two-column shell with real trust copy (frames, proofs, runtime verification) but the one-scale bar is only convincing on Account and Settings; Home, Activity, Receipt, Receive, and Swap break comparability. Light theme also introduces a black All chip, grey theme toggle, and hairline-zero bars that read as chrome rather than money.
priority_fixes: Enforce 1px=$50 on every bar (Home total, USDC row, Hub One, Pay Before/After, Receive amount, Swap pay, Activity amounts) and fade at card edge — delete any bar that is a full-width decoration at $0.
Home: remove the On-chain/Reserve/Accounts dollar legend and the Instant send/receive duplicate; let the total and the account card each speak once.
Activity + Receipt: represent −25.00 / +10,000.00 on the same scale; auto-open the latest receipt instead of the empty Select a movement card.
One primary fill: indigo #6E7CFF for Pay/Copy/selected filter; stop using black All and washed lavender Swap-as-enabled.
Pay/Swap/Receive: one amount format (tabular 25.00 USDC), one share/CTA, and don’t repeat Hub One bars in both columns.
